name: Nihon Suido Consultants Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nihon Suido Consultants Co., Ltd. provides construction consulting for water supply and sewerage in Japan and abroad. Its work spans investigation, planning and design, supervising construction, running facilities, diagnosis, water quality inspection and financial analysis, as well as flood control and river and lake environmental management. It also sells and leases materials and equipment. It dates from 1959 and has its base in Tokyo, Japan.
